effect.name: Photoshop Lighten (Background)
effect.description: (The effect comes from the Photoshop) Looks at the color information in each channel and selects the base or blend color - whichever is lighter - as the result color. Pixels darker than the blend color are replaced, and pixels lighter than the blend color do not change
effect.author: Foxioo
